newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN says exceptionals could weigh on year.
newsitem.headline: GAN says exceptionals could weigh on year.

text.p: French state-owned insurer GAN on Wednesday announced a first half net consolidated loss of 965 million francs and said exceptional items could have a negative impact on the company's full year 1996 result.
"Despite the recovery of insurance results and good results shown by CIC, exceptional items could have a negative impact on the results of GAN in 1996," the company said in a statement.
The group added that it was studying ways to boost shareholder funds ahead of its privatisation which has been expected for next year.
"The group is studying ways to reinforce shareholder funds looking ahead to its privatisation," the insurer said in a statement.
